response.original_title: {Claim Update} How to File a Claim with Cunard Cruise
response.overview: To file a claim with Cunard Cruise (USA) for nonperformance +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) (refunds), submit a written claim with booking confirmation, proof of payment, and supporting documents to their +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) Fort Lauderdale office via certified mail. For lost or damaged luggage, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) you must report it to staff at the terminal immediately upon disembarkation to fill out a mandatory report. Action: Speak to a staff member at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) the terminal immediately upon disembarkation to complete the required luggage form. Customer Service: Call +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) (Mon-Fri 8 AM–11 PM, Sat-Sun 9 AM–9 PM EST).
